+package database
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"net"
+	"strings"
+	"syscall"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/trace"
+	mssql "github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb"
+	"github.com/microsoft/go-mssqldb/msdsn"
+
+	"github.com/gravitational/teleport/lib/defaults"
+)
+
+// SQLServerPinger tests connections to SQL Server databases.
+type SQLServerPinger struct{}
+
+// Ping connects to SQL Server using the database login supplied by the user.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) Ping(ctx context.Context, params PingParams) error {
+	if err := params.CheckAndSetDefaults(defaults.ProtocolSQLServer); err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	if params.Port < 1 || params.Port > 65535 {
+		return trace.BadParameter("invalid SQL Server port %d", params.Port)
+	}
+
+	connector := mssql.NewConnectorConfig(msdsn.Config{
+		Host:       params.Host,
+		Port:       uint64(params.Port),
+		User:       params.Username,
+		Database:   params.DatabaseName,
+		Encryption: msdsn.EncryptionDisabled,
+		Protocols:  []string{"tcp"},
+	}, nil)
+	connector.Dialer = sqlServerContextDialer{ctx: ctx}
+	conn, err := connector.Connect(ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		if ctx.Err() != nil {
+			return trace.Wrap(ctx.Err())
+		}
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	if err := conn.Close(); err != nil {
+		return trace.Wrap(err)
+	}
+	return trace.Wrap(ctx.Err())
+}
+
+// The SQL Server driver uses the context for dialing, but its login handshake
+// can block on network reads. Keep the same deadline and cancellation in force
+// until the connection is closed.
+type sqlServerContextDialer struct {
+	ctx context.Context
+}
+
+func (d sqlServerContextDialer) DialContext(ctx context.Context, network, addr string) (net.Conn, error) {
+	conn, err := (&net.Dialer{}).DialContext(ctx, network, addr)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	if deadline, ok := d.ctx.Deadline(); ok {
+		if err := conn.SetDeadline(deadline); err != nil {
+			conn.Close()
+			return nil, err
+		}
+	}
+	return &sqlServerContextConn{
+		Conn: conn,
+		stop: context.AfterFunc(d.ctx, func() { conn.Close() }),
+	}, nil
+}
+
+type sqlServerContextConn struct {
+	net.Conn
+	stop func() bool
+}
+
+func (c *sqlServerContextConn) Close() error {
+	c.stop()
+	return c.Conn.Close()
+}
+
+// IsConnectionRefusedError reports a refused TCP connection.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsConnectionRefusedError(err error) bool {
+	return errors.Is(err, syscall.ECONNREFUSED) ||
+		(err != nil && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "connection refused"))
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseUserError reports a rejected SQL Server login.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(err error) bool {
+	var sqlErr interface {
+		SQLErrorNumber() int32
+		SQLErrorState() uint8
+	}
+	if errors.As(err, &sqlErr) {
+		switch sqlErr.SQLErrorNumber() {
+		case 18456:
+			return sqlErr.SQLErrorState() != 38
+		case 28353: // Teleport forwards backend errors with this number.
+		default:
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return err != nil && strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(err.Error()), "login failed for user") &&
+		!p.IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(err)
+}
+
+// IsInvalidDatabaseNameError reports a database that could not be opened.
+func (p *SQLServerPinger) IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(err error) bool {
+	var sqlErr interface {
+		SQLErrorNumber() int32
+		SQLErrorState() uint8
+	}
+	if errors.As(err, &sqlErr) {
+		switch sqlErr.SQLErrorNumber() {
+		case 4060:
+			return true
+		case 18456:
+			return sqlErr.SQLErrorState() == 38
+		case 28353: // Teleport forwards backend errors with this number.
+		default:
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	if err == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	message := strings.ToLower(err.Error())
+	return strings.Contains(message, "cannot open database") ||
+		strings.Contains(message, "failed to open the explicitly specified database") ||
+		strings.Contains(message, "cannot open user default database")
+}

+
+func TestSQLServerPing(t *testing.T) {
+	server, err := sqlserver.NewTestServer(common.TestServerConfig{})
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, server.Close()) })
+	go func() { require.NoError(t, server.Serve()) }()
+
+	port, err := strconv.Atoi(server.Port())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	params := PingParams{Host: "localhost", Port: port, Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb"}
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
+	defer cancel()
+	require.NoError(t, (&SQLServerPinger{}).Ping(ctx, params))
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPingValidationAndDeadline(t *testing.T) {
+	pinger := &SQLServerPinger{}
+	params := PingParams{Host: "localhost", Port: 1433, Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb"}
+	for _, invalid := range []PingParams{
+		{Host: params.Host, Port: params.Port, DatabaseName: params.DatabaseName},
+		{Host: params.Host, Port: params.Port, Username: params.Username},
+		{Host: params.Host, Port: -1, Username: params.Username, DatabaseName: params.DatabaseName},
+		{Host: params.Host, Port: 65536, Username: params.Username, DatabaseName: params.DatabaseName},
+	} {
+		require.Error(t, pinger.Ping(context.Background(), invalid))
+	}
+
+	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "localhost:0")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	t.Cleanup(func() { require.NoError(t, listener.Close()) })
+	_, portStr, err := net.SplitHostPort(listener.Addr().String())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	params.Port, err = strconv.Atoi(portStr)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	go func() {
+		conn, err := listener.Accept()
+		if err == nil {
+			defer conn.Close()
+			<-time.After(time.Second)
+		}
+	}()
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 100*time.Millisecond)
+	defer cancel()
+	start := time.Now()
+	err = pinger.Ping(ctx, params)
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.Less(t, time.Since(start), time.Second)
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerPingConnectionRefused(t *testing.T) {
+	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "localhost:0")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	_, portStr, err := net.SplitHostPort(listener.Addr().String())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	port, err := strconv.Atoi(portStr)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.NoError(t, listener.Close())
+
+	pinger := &SQLServerPinger{}
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
+	defer cancel()
+	err = pinger.Ping(ctx, PingParams{Host: "localhost", Port: port, Username: "someuser", DatabaseName: "somedb"})
+	require.Error(t, err)
+	require.True(t, pinger.IsConnectionRefusedError(err))
+}
+
+func TestSQLServerErrors(t *testing.T) {
+	pinger := &SQLServerPinger{}
+	tests := []struct {
+		name, category string
+		err            error
+	}{
+		{"refused network error", "refused", fmt.Errorf("dial: %w", syscall.ECONNREFUSED)},
+		{"refused proxy error", "refused", errors.New("dial tcp: connection refused")},
+		{"invalid user", "user", fmt.Errorf("login: %w", &mssql.Error{Number: 18456})},
+		{"invalid database", "database", fmt.Errorf("login: %w", &mssql.Error{Number: 4060})},
+		{"invalid database login state", "database", &mssql.Error{Number: 18456, State: 38}},
+		{"forwarded invalid user", "user", &mssql.Error{Number: 28353, Message: "Login failed for user 'unknown'"}},
+		{"forwarded invalid database", "database", &mssql.Error{Number: 28353, Message: "Cannot open database 'unknown' requested by the login"}},
+		{"other SQL error", "", &mssql.Error{Number: 207}},
+		{"nil error", "", nil},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			require.Equal(t, tt.category == "refused", pinger.IsConnectionRefusedError(tt.err))
+			require.Equal(t, tt.category == "user", pinger.IsInvalidDatabaseUserError(tt.err))
+			require.Equal(t, tt.category == "database", pinger.IsInvalidDatabaseNameError(tt.err))
+		})
+	}
+}
